status: local controlled vocabulary, not a recognized domain ontology

relations.associated_with: A statistical or observational association; does not imply causation.
relations.predicts: Subject predicts object in the reported model/setting; does not imply causation.
relations.increases: Object is higher under the subject condition versus the explicit comparator; causal attribution must be supported separately.
relations.decreases: Object is lower under the subject condition versus the explicit comparator; causal attribution must be supported separately.
relations.causes: An explicitly supported causal assertion; do not map association to this relation.
relations.inhibits: Reported inhibition of the object in the stated experimental scope.
relations.activates: Reported activation of the object in the stated experimental scope.
relations.has_value: A defined subject quantity has the object value/unit under retained conditions.
relations.compared_with: An explicit comparison; direction and metric remain in the claim and scope.
relations.part_of: Subject is a component of object, not the reverse.
relations.related_to: Fallback relation requiring an exact textual explanation and review; no stronger semantics implied.
